assets.purpose: Compilation and linking pipeline
assets.alt_text: Source → preprocessing → compilation → assembly → linking → executable.
assets.caption: Source → preprocessing → compilation → assembly → linking → executable.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Pointer and object relationship
assets.alt_text: A pointer object stores an address that can designate a separate live object.
assets.caption: A pointer object stores an address that can designate a separate live object.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Dynamic allocation lifecycle
assets.alt_text: Check allocation, use the live allocation, release it once, and never use the old pointer again.
assets.caption: Check allocation, use the live allocation, release it once, and never use the old pointer again.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Null-terminated string
assets.alt_text: A C string consists of characters followed by a null terminator within its accessible storage.
assets.caption: A C string consists of characters followed by a null terminator within its accessible storage.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: File stream lifecycle
assets.alt_text: Opening a stream can fail; successful streams should be used with checked operations and closed.
assets.caption: Opening a stream can fail; successful streams should be used with checked operations and closed.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Bit mask operations
assets.alt_text: Use unsigned masks to set, clear, toggle and test selected bits.
assets.caption: Use unsigned masks to set, clear, toggle and test selected bits.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Sorting trace
assets.alt_text: An insertion-sort pass expands a sorted prefix one element at a time.
assets.caption: An insertion-sort pass expands a sorted prefix one element at a time.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Linked list links
assets.alt_text: Nodes store data and a pointer to the next node; the final next pointer is null.
assets.caption: Nodes store data and a pointer to the next node; the final next pointer is null.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Concurrent memory overview
assets.alt_text: Shared memory needs a defined synchronization strategy; atomics synchronize atomic objects, locks or other mechanisms protect coordinated state.
assets.caption: Shared memory needs a defined synchronization strategy; atomics synchronize atomic objects, locks or other mechanisms protect coordinated state.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Defensive input handling
assets.alt_text: Treat external data as untrusted and validate length, conversion status, range, and semantic constraints.
assets.caption: Treat external data as untrusted and validate length, conversion status, range, and semantic constraints.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Test and debug cycle
assets.alt_text: A reproducible workflow isolates a failure, tests a fix, and prevents regressions.
assets.caption: A reproducible workflow isolates a failure, tests a fix, and prevents regressions.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Professional build workflow
assets.alt_text: Versioned source moves through repeatable builds, review, tests and release artifacts.
assets.caption: Versioned source moves through repeatable builds, review, tests and release artifacts.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Embedded memory map
assets.alt_text: Embedded programs work within a target-defined memory map and peripheral interfaces.
assets.caption: Embedded programs work within a target-defined memory map and peripheral interfaces.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: ABI boundary
assets.alt_text: An ABI contract includes calling conventions, symbol names, layout and ownership rules across compiled components.
assets.caption: An ABI contract includes calling conventions, symbol names, layout and ownership rules across compiled components.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Two-dimensional array layout
assets.alt_text: Rows of a true C multidimensional array are stored contiguously in row-major order.
assets.caption: Rows of a true C multidimensional array are stored contiguously in row-major order.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Finite-state machine
assets.alt_text: A state machine names allowed states and transitions triggered by events or conditions.
assets.caption: A state machine names allowed states and transitions triggered by events or conditions.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Application layers
assets.alt_text: Keep input/output, domain logic, persistence and platform integration behind clear interfaces.
assets.caption: Keep input/output, domain logic, persistence and platform integration behind clear interfaces.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: C learning roadmap
assets.alt_text: Move from portable core language skills into safety, tooling, advanced semantics and specialization.
assets.caption: Move from portable core language skills into safety, tooling, advanced semantics and specialization.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf educational diagram created for this course.

assets.purpose: Array indexing
assets.alt_text: Array elements occupy contiguous positions and indices must stay between zero and count minus one.
